hypotheses.justification: Split into nonempty and empty cases for ι. In the nonempty case, use the existing proof via the drift theorem. If ι is empty, EuclideanSpace ℝ ι is subsingleton: PiLp.ext proves any two points equal by eliminating their coordinate index. Thus every K is subsingleton, and Set.Subsingleton.holderOnWith gives the conclusion with α = 1 and C = 0 for any precise representative. This also covers empty K and requires none of the PDE assumptions in that branch.
